key.name: last-usage
key.summary: Last usage response (numbers only, no token); lets the settings window list limits and draw its preview

key.name: number-mode
key.summary: Show percent used or percent left

key.name: color-enabled
key.summary: Tint the indicator green / amber / red

key.name: show-limits
key.summary: Week and model limits in the bar: only when amber or red, or always

key.name: pace-hours
key.summary: Weekly pace over working hours only, or over all hours

key.name: amber-at
key.summary: Amber when a limit projects to end its window at or above this percent

key.name: model-colour
key.summary: How far a used-up model-specific limit (e.g. Fable) may colour the whole indicator

key.name: countdown-mode
key.summary: When to show the countdown in the top bar: the session reset, or the red limit that stops you first

key.name: time-style
key.summary: Countdown as time left or as clock time

key.name: auto-renew
key.summary: Renew an expired Claude Code login through the claude CLI (single-use refresh token; can race a running Claude Code)
